title: Bacon and Savoy Cabbage Pasta
description: A keto indulgent twist on traditional pasta dishes, featuring crispy bacon and sautéed savoy cabbage. This Portuguese-inspired recipe is a delicious alternative to traditional pasta.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, cook the bacon over medium heat until crispy. Remove from heat and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the butter and sauté the garlic until fragrant.
Add the savoy cabbage to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet and toss with the cabbage mixture.
Return the cooked bacon to the skillet and toss to combine.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
